The '''Veccacopia system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that lay within the [[Tunka sector/Legends|Tunka sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the astronomical object [[Veccacopia]], which was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Cacop]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="NEGTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Veccacopia system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square I-19.<ref name="EAOC" />
